title: Proposal: raise the memory gate to 85% / 95%, and the 48 GB page file

owner_note.text: Proposal, not built: once early relief at 70% lands, raise the gate to 85% (minions wait) and 95% (nothing starts) with SERVEX_COMMIT_HIGH_PCT=85 / SERVEX_COMMIT_FULL_PCT=95. A 48 GB page file lifts the limit from ~57 to ~80 GB, so today's 36 GB use would read 45% instead of 63%; it costs disk, not speed, unless the PC really pages. My pick: do the page file first, keep 80/90 for a week, and raise only if spawns still queue. The other option: raise now and skip the page file.
